merge_static_archives: run merge_archives.py with -o flag to merge multiple .a static libraries into one output archive
merge_archives_verbose: run merge_archives.py with -v flag to merge static archives and print verbose command output
merge_archives_with_search_paths: run merge_archives.py with -L flag to merge archives found in custom library search paths
merge_archives_custom_ar: run merge_archives.py with --ar flag to merge static archives using a custom ar executable
execute_command_verbose: use execute_command_verbose to run a shell command and print output on failure or when verbose is true
